page: Amazon Web Services c9gd.metal-48xl is a bare-metal, compute-optimized server powered by AWS Graviton ARM64 processors. This instance features 192 dedicated physical cores running at 3.3 GHz with a single thread per core, delivering high-density parallel processing capabilities. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

The server includes 11,400 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage, offering high-capacity, low-latency local disk access. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfer for distributed environments. No graphics processing units are included in this configuration.

The ARM64 architecture and dedicated core allocation offer high compute efficiency per resource unit, though the 2.0 GB per core memory allocation represents a tradeoff for memory-bound applications. This hardware profile is suited for compute-heavy workloads that require high-speed local scratch space, such as batch processing, video encoding, distributed analytics, and large-scale containerized deployments.
